title: Validation: saving with empty required fields shows alert and blocks submission

category: 마이페이지 광고 등록 (My-shop multi-step Ad creation)
additionalInstructions: Must use corporate account. The form has NO step-by-step '다음' navigation button. Validation is triggered by the '저장 및 심사' button at the bottom of the page. On validation failure, a browser alert dialog appears with text '필수 항목 누락'. Accept/dismiss the dialog and verify the form page is still visible (URL still contains view=form).

additionalInstructions: Community posts are accessible ONLY to logged-in personal users (개인회원). Non-logged-in users see '그녀들만의 비밀 커뮤니티' login modal when clicking posts — this is intentional app behavior, NOT a bug. Must login as personal user before clicking a post. Use autoLogin=personal or login flow before navigating to /community.

Verify a list of community posts is visible on the page
Click on the first post item in the list
Verify URL changes to contain "/community/" followed by a post ID

title: Customer Center: Switch between FAQ and Inquiry tabs via URL params
description: Verifies the Customer Center tab navigation updates visible content. Tab switching works via URL query params (?tab=faq, ?tab=inquiry). After clicking a tab, wait for navigation and React state update before asserting content.
additionalInstructions: Tab switching uses router.push with ?tab= query param, then a useEffect detects the searchParams change and updates the activeTab state. Allow at least 500ms after tab click before asserting content change. The '자주묻는질문' tab maps to ?tab=faq, '1:1 문의' tab maps to ?tab=inquiry.

steps.description: Verify text "자주묻는질문" tab is active and FAQ content is visible
Click on the "1:1 문의" tab in the sidebar
Wait 500ms for React state update after URL change
Verify "1:1 문의" content area is now visible (FAQ content is no longer shown)
Verify FAQ question list is visible again
